callees.name: _is_valid_spec_json
callees.pre_condition: spec is a dict parsed from a JSON file.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when spec contains exactly the keys "signature", "pre_condition", "post_condition" and every value is of type str; returns False otherwise.

callees.name: _is_valid_info_json
callees.pre_condition: info is a dict parsed from a JSON file.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when info contains exactly the key "callees" whose value is an array, and every element of that array is a dict containing exactly the keys "name", "signature", "pre_condition", "post_condition" with all values of type str; returns False otherwise.
